fields.label: Call Log Level
fields.help: Describes the level of platform logging to apply to calls and call responses during executions of this workflow.

fields.label: Crypto Key Name
fields.help: The KMS key used to encrypt workflow and execution data.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the workflow.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: Description of the workflow provided by the user.

fields.label: Execution History Level
fields.help: Describes the level of execution history to be stored for this workflow.

fields.label: Service Account
fields.help: Name of the service account associated with the latest workflow version.
